message.subject: Epson + protective film partnership idea
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Congrats on the S9170 launch at PRINTING United—saw the Pinnacle Awards recognition.

I'm reaching out because we work with printer manufacturers who want to differentiate their outdoor graphics solutions beyond print quality alone. When your customers ask about protecting vehicle wraps or architectural graphics from UV damage and graffiti, having a validated protective film partnership can be the difference in winning those municipal and transit RFPs.

Would you be open to a brief call to explore what a joint solution might look like ahead of ISA Sign Expo? Happy to share how similar partnerships have increased equipment utilization and competitive win rates.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Recent S9170 launch momentum and Pinnacle Awards recognition, plus upcoming ISA Sign Expo presence
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Strategic partnership for competitive differentiation in outdoor graphics RFPs, focusing on business outcomes (win rates, equipment utilization) rather than technical specs
